dex.entry: A small, round snow-vole that buries itself just below the glacier surface and pops up to startle travellers. Its breath muffles all nearby sounds — experienced Pale Vault guides say you've entered Hushvole territory when your footsteps go quiet. The sound-muffling concept is evocative and spooky in
